 )::text,'sha256'),'hex'),
'publications',(SELECT count(*) FROM finance.financial_reports WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c'),

'exports',(SELECT count(*) FROM core.export_jobs WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c')) AS facts
